defs.def: to hold sth firmly and use force in order to move it or try to move it towards yourself 拉；拽；扯；拖

ex.s: I flashed him an apologetic smile as I pulled out my Portuguese bankcard.
ex.t: 我一边露出歉意的微笑，一边掏出我的葡萄牙银行卡。

ex.s: I flashed him an apologetic smile as I pulled out my Portuguese bankcard.
ex.t: 我一边露出歉意的微笑，一边掏出我的葡萄牙银行卡。

ex.s: They pulled the sausage beyond the dog’s reach.
ex.t: 他们把香肠拉到狗够不到的地方。

ex.s: He pulled and bit the wire.
ex.t: 它用后腿站立推着木制围栏柱。

ex.s: He pulls out a special device, points it at the suspect, and switches it on.
ex.t: 他拿出一件特殊装置，对准嫌疑人，然后打开开关。

ex.s: （1分）It was only when the car pulled up in front of our house               we saw Lily in the passenger seat．（  ）
ex.t: 14．（1分）只有当汽车停在我们家门前时，____我们才看到副驾驶座上的莉莉。（  ）

ex.s: Alistair ran towards Jonny, caught him and started pulling him towards the finish line.
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔跑向乔尼，抓住了他，开始把他拉向终点线。

ex.s: Suddenly, she is pulled underwater.
ex.t: 突然，她被拉到了水下。

ex.s: Last week, I went to the butcher's and asked "Do you have pigs'ears?""No,"the butcher said, pulling at his own ears,"just these ordinary ones."He must have thought I was joking.
ex.t: 上周，我去肉铺问：“你们有猪耳朵吗？”“没有，”肉贩拉着自己的耳朵说，“只有这些普通的。”他一定以为我在开玩笑。

ex.s: Last October , while tending her garden in Mora , Sweden , Lena Pahlsson pulled out a handful of small   56  (carrot) and was about to throw them away.
ex.t: 去年10月，莉娜·帕尔松（ Lena Pahlsson ）在瑞典莫拉（ Mora ）照料花园时，拿出一把小小的56 （胡萝卜） ，准备把它们扔掉。

ex.s: Long curtains had been pulled around my bed,  16  me from the other patients.
ex.t: 长窗帘已经被拉到我的床边，16 把我和其他病人隔开。

ex.s: Next time you see a young person lost in thought, don’t rush to pull them back.
ex.t: 下次你看到一个陷入沉思的年轻人，不要急着把他们拉回来。

defs.def: to remove sth from a place by pulling 拔出；抽出

ex.s: Turning soil, pulling weeds, and harvesting cabbage sound like tough work for middle and high school kids.
ex.t: 翻土、拔草和收卷心菜，对中学生和高中生来说听起来像是艰苦的劳动。

defs.def: to move sb/sth in a particular direction by pulling （向某方向）拖，拉动
to hold or be attached to sth and move it along behind you 将 … 拖在身后；拉；牵引

ex.s: Sprinklers and fire alarm pull stations．
ex.t: D. 喷洒器和火警牵引站。

defs.def: to move your body or a part of your body in a particular direction, especially using force 扭转；移开；抽回
to open or close curtains, etc. 拉上；收拢
to damage a muscle, etc. by using too much force 拉伤；扭伤；抻
to move a switch, etc. towards yourself or down in order to operate a machine or piece of equipment 扳动；拉；扣
to move or make a vehicle move sideways （使车辆）转向，打斜
to work hard and use a lot of power 发动机
to use oars to move a boat along 划；划动
to attract the interest or support of sb/sth 吸引；博取

ex.s: The Socrates Express is a fun, sharp book that draws readers in with its apparent simplicity and gradually pulls them in deeper thoughts on desire, loneliness, and aging.
ex.t: 《苏格拉底快线》是一本有趣而犀利的书，以其表面的简单吸引读者，逐渐将他们带入对欲望、孤独和衰老的更深思考。

defs.def: to attract sb sexually 吸引异性
to succeed in playing a trick on sb, committing a crime, etc. （耍手腕）得逞；犯下（罪行）
to cancel an event; to stop showing an advertisement, etc. 取消，撤销（活动、广告等）
to move back from a place 军队

ex.s: She tried to pull the shoe back on, but it cost her precious time.
ex.t: 她试图把鞋穿回去，但这耗费了她宝贵的时间。

defs.def: to decide not to do sth that you were intending to do, because of possible problems 退出；退却
to destroy a building completely 捣毁，拆毁，摧毁（建筑物）
to enter a station and stop 火车
to move to the side of the road or to the place mentioned and stop 车辆或司机
to leave a station 火车
to move away from sth or stop being involved in it 脱离；退出

ex.s: If you see a painting of a movement, like of a man pulling his arm away after being bitten by a dog, you feel like going through a similar experience.
ex.t: 如果你看到一幅描绘运动的画作，比如一个人被狗咬后缩回手臂的画面，你会感觉自己仿佛经历了类似的体验。

ex.s: He pulled in front of it as the wolf was catching up fast, just a dozen yards away now.
ex.t: 他冲到那辆车前面，这时狼正在快速逼近，只有十几码远了。

defs.def: to get better after a serious illness, operation, etc. （大病、手术等后）康复，痊愈
to succeed in doing sth very difficult 完成，做成（十分困难的事）

ex.s: The Barcelona subway pulls into the station, the doors slide open and passengers pour out to go about their daily business.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那地铁驶入车站，门滑开，乘客涌出，去忙各自日常的事。

defs.def: to help sb get better after a serious illness, operation, etc. 帮 … 复原（或康复）
to help sb succeed in doing sth very difficult 协助 … 完成（十分困难的事）
an act of trying to make sth move by holding it firmly and bringing it towards you 拉；拽；扯
a strong physical force that makes sth move in a particular direction 力；引力；磁力
the fact of sth attracting you or having a strong effect on you 吸引力；诱惑；影响
power and influence over other people （对他人的）影响，影响力

ex.s: If you feel one of your teammate isn’t pulling their weight, then raise your concerns in a professional way with your team coach If you think about other people’s feelings as well as your own, you’ll soon find everything works out.
ex.t: 如果你觉得团队中的某个成员没有尽到自己的责任，那就以专业的方式向你们的团队教练提出你的担忧 如果你能顾及他人的感受和自己的感受，你很快就会发现一切都会顺利的。

defs.def: an act of taking a deep breath of smoke from a cigarette, etc. or a deep drink of sth 深吸；大口喝
a difficult walk up a steep hill 艰难攀登
an injury to a muscle caused by using too much force 拉伤；扭伤
something such as a handle or rope that you use to pull sth 尤用于构成复合词

ex.s: But instead of passing it through the hole to the dog, they would then pull it out of its reach.
ex.t: 但他们没有把它穿过洞递给狗，而是把它拉到狗够不着的地方。

ex.s: Each has to pull their own weight.
ex.t: 每个人都必须尽自己的一份力。

ex.s: I can, from my computer at home, pull up satellite images of Juan’s village.
ex.t: 我可以在家里的电脑上调出胡安村庄的卫星图像。

ex.s: Fire alarm pull stations and pipes．
ex.t: C． 火警报警按钮和管道。
